name: Empty
summary: The placeholder for a surface that has no data yet.
highlights: Placeholder for a surface with no data yet
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-empty> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. The DS V3 Empty is a small family: an `image` (the pink empty-list illustration at 64 px by default, the same art at 48 px as `simple` for tight surfaces, `none` for a text-only empty state, or a custom picture via slot="image"), a caption from the `description` attribute or the default slot (description="" hides it), and an optional action (slot="action"). A static marker — no interactive state, so no motion. Zero drift — the same element.
codeNote: The built-in illustration is empty-list from the illustration registry, called by name through <aha-illustration> (loaded with the element), never inline SVG; slot="image" can supersede it with any picture (empty-table in a table body, or an <aha-icon>). antd components draw their own grey Empty picture: pass createRenderEmpty({ h }) from @ahaslides-product/design/antd-render-empty as the root ConfigProvider's renderEmpty and every Select, Cascader, TreeSelect, Transfer, List and Table shows <aha-empty> instead. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: image
props.desc: Built-in illustration: the empty-list illustration at 64 px, or at 48 px with tighter spacing for tight surfaces (simple); none hides the illustration (text-only)

props.name: description
props.desc: The caption; falls back to the default slot when absent, and renders nothing when set to ""

props.name: image
props.desc: A custom picture (e.g. an <aha-icon>) that supersedes the built-in illustration

props.name: action
props.desc: An optional call to action (a button or link)

whenToUse.when: a list, table, or panel has nothing to show yet
reporting the outcome of an action (success, 404)

opinion.note: The caption says what's missing and, ideally, the next step — 'No responses yet — share the join link'. Keep one action; an empty state is a nudge, not a menu. <aha-empty> is for small, tight surfaces (a table body, a list, a dropdown, under 240 px). In a table body it holds the pink empty-table illustration in slot="image" at 64 px (DataTable does this by default); a list, dropdown or widget shows its built-in pink empty-list illustration (image="simple" when tight). antd components get the same through createRenderEmpty on the root ConfigProvider, so no screen shows antd's grey Empty picture. A page or a panel uses the full Empty state pattern, with a pink empty-* illustration (guidelines/empty-state).
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 <Empty> component-set (fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy: <Empty> set + Empty/Customize + a separate Illustration component), matching antd Empty's matrix: a default illustration vs a smaller `simple` image, a `description` (or none), a custom picture (Customize / slot="image"), and an optional action. The caption colour comes from the token layer (text-tertiary); the art is the DS empty-list illustration in the illustration tints, replacing the grey line art — a deliberate extension, not a per-cell measured match.
